usedFor: Shopify holds the product catalog; AudioPod AI turns text into voice. A “New Product” in Shopify can run “Generate Speech” to produce an audio read of the listing.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Generate Speech” in AudioPod AI
bestTemplate.why: A new listing becomes an audio clip with a voice, speed, format and language you pick, which fits product videos or accessibility.

watchOut: “Separate Stems” needs a link to a song, which none of the Shopify triggers supply. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so any audio built from it runs after the next check.
